theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : Set (α → β)) (s : Set α) [Finite ↑f] [Finite ↑s] : Finite ↑(f.seq s) := by
  let f_set := ↑f
  let s_set := ↑s
  have h_finite_f : Finite f_set := by exact infer_instance
  have h_finite_s : Finite s_set := by exact infer_instance
  have h_finite_functions : ∀ t ∈ f_set, Finite { g | ∀ x ∈ s_set, g x ∈ t } :=
    by rintro t ht; exact Finite.set_of_functions h_finite_s ht
  have h_union_finite : Finite (⋃ t ∈ f_set, { g | ∀ x ∈ s_set, g x ∈ t }) :=
    by exact Finite.union h_finite_f (by intro t ht; exact h_finite_functions t ht)
  exact h_union_finite
